'''Noelle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Noelle was a friend of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Lora Nadad]]. Following the end if the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the surviving [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] went into hiding and Nadad hid out in [[Jax Warehouse]] on Cularin. Noelle stayed there with her, along with [[Ledis]] and [[Klide]], some of Nadad's other friends. Noelle was present there when the [[heroes of Cularin]] traveled to the warehouse.

==Personality and traits==
Noelle was tall and big-boned, with blonde hair. Her eyes had a vacant look.
